decision_required: Define what the metric measures. It currently restates the schedule performance index under a compression name.
available_options: 1. Measure compression against a governed required completion date, which needs that date carried as a project input. 2. Retire the compression name and report it as the schedule performance restatement it is. 3. Retire the module.
literature_basis: Specification 11 requires compression to be measured against a required completion, not inferred from a performance index. No literature supports calling a performance index a compression measure.
engineering_consequence: Option 1 needs a new governed input and a data contract; option 2 is a naming correction with no arithmetic change.
voting_effect: none; non-voting and it stays non-voting under every option
recommended_default_safe_state: NON-VOTING and ADVISORY, unchanged, with the truthful proxy name applied only once the owner selects between options 2 and 3
what_remains_blocked: the label correction, because renaming to a transparent proxy pre-empts option 1

decision_required: Category placement, and whether this module, 10.4 What-If Scenario Matrix and 10.7 should share one governed decision object.
available_options: 1. Keep three separate modules with three separate identities. 2. Merge onto one governed decision object with one alternatives, objectives and constraints structure. 3. Keep separate but declare the shared lineage so they cannot corroborate one another.
literature_basis: Specification 19 requires alternatives, objectives, constraints and a payoff structure for decision modules; three modules over one structure is a lineage question as much as a placement one.
engineering_consequence: Option 2 is a structural change across three modules; option 3 is a lineage declaration only.
recommended_default_safe_state: NON-VOTING and ADVISORY, with the lineage between the three declared as dependent whichever option is chosen, since that is safe under all three
what_remains_blocked: the structural work for 5.4, 10.4 and 10.7, because it cannot be done twice

decision_required: Define the pattern the module detects, the feature space it spans and the neighbourhood radius, or rename it.
available_options: 1. Declare pattern, features and radius, making it a specified detector. 2. Rename it a near-neighbour count, which is what it computes. 3. Retire it.
literature_basis: Specification 20 requires PH.2 to PH.5 be evaluated against their own declared descriptive contracts and forbids borrowing Isolation Forest's pedigree for them.
engineering_consequence: Option 1 needs a declared feature space and a calibration objective; option 2 is a naming correction.
what_remains_blocked: both the specification work and the label correction

decision_required: Whether the module keeps the analogous estimating name once it is clear it is a proxy, or is renamed.
available_options: 1. Carry identified analogs with comparability criteria, normalisation and adaptation factors, which makes the canonical name truthful. 2. Rename it to the transparent indicator it is.
literature_basis: Specification 12 section 3.7 states in terms that a single preloaded analog overrun percent without analog selection or provenance is only a proxy.
engineering_consequence: Option 1 needs an analogs structure and a data contract; option 2 is a naming correction.
recommended_default_safe_state: NON-VOTING and ADVISORY, unchanged; the invalid-evidence defect is closed independently of this decision
what_remains_blocked: the label correction only; the P0B fix did not wait on it

module: The within-body combination operator for the two voting modules
decision_required: RATIFICATION, not a blocked decision. The scientific requirement is that a same-lineage addition may not manufacture corroboration, and that requirement is satisfied by ANY idempotent within-body operator. The choice among idempotent operators is governance policy and not science, and the one implemented takes the most adverse of the readings of the one body of evidence. Ratify it or name another.
available_options: 1. Ratify the most adverse reading, which is what is implemented and which never manufactures reassurance. 2. Choose another idempotent operator, for example the reading of a named primary module with the other reported as a corroborating view. 3. Require a published dependence-aware combination rule such as a cautious conjunctive rule, which would need its canonical decomposition implemented and tested.
literature_basis: Specification 22 points 4 and 5, and specification 24 which forbids a second function copied from the first as an oracle. Dempster's rule assumes independent bodies of evidence; nothing in the literature licenses applying it to two transforms of one body. No source states which idempotent operator a governed cost status should use.
engineering_consequence: Option 1 is delivered. Option 2 is a small change at the same call site. Option 3 is substantial and would need its own cycle.
voting_effect: Voting remains exactly two modules under every option. Under option 1 the band moves in two of the sixteen combinations relative to the pre-fix rule, both times from Green to Yellow, which is the adverse direction.
participant_effect: A project whose two cost readings are Green and Yellow now shows Cost Recovery Status Yellow where it previously showed Green. No other combination changes band. No boundary, band or module arithmetic moved.
recommended_default_safe_state: Option 1, the most adverse reading, which is in place and which cannot manufacture reassurance.
what_remains_blocked: Nothing. The scientific defect is closed under option 1 and the register records ARCH.2 as CLOSED_RUN20; this row asks the owner to confirm the policy choice rather than the science.
